up: Retrieve IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against human target Bifunctional epoxide hydrolase 2 (CHEMBL2409). For each activity, return the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI (prioritize PubMed ID, fallback to DOI), assay description, and target details. Filter for activities where standard_type is IC50 and standard_units are nM. Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, and docs tables.
sql:
SELECT
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    cr.compound_key,
    COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
    a.assay_description,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    a.standard_value AS ic50_nM
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2409'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM';
